name: spec
description: Standalone product-spec stage. Checks out an existing pipeline branch, runs an interactive product-only spec interview (optionally clarified by an idea doc), writes docs/specs/<date>-<slug>-spec.md at a computed path under the slug it was given, verifies it on disk, then pushes and records the spec entry in the pipeline manifest.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Existing remote branch to check out and commit the spec on.

inputs.name: slug
inputs.description: Feature slug. Kept as given; the spec stage never re-slugs.

inputs.name: base_branch
inputs.description: Recorded as the manifest's top-level base_branch when this stage's finish creates the manifest. Empty leaves it unset.

inputs.name: teams_webhook_url
inputs.description: Teams webhook URL, accepted for parity with the other stages. Leave empty in the committed sample.

inputs.name: idea_path
inputs.description: Optional path of an idea doc on the branch, read as clarification material for a product-only spec.

nodes.label: Init workspace
nodes.description: Clone repo_url and add a worktree at ./work on the existing remote branch.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift work_dir and run_date to top-level vars and compute the spec target path from the given slug.

nodes.label: Resolve inputs
nodes.description: An explicit idea_path wins; otherwise it defaults to empty (no idea doc).

nodes.label: Brainstorm: spec
nodes.description: Interactive product-spec interview. Reads the optional idea doc as clarification material, writes ./work/{{spec_target}} and commits locally. Not on a cycle; never pushes.

nodes.label: Checkpoint: push session
nodes.description: Pushes the approved spec session before finalize-spec, so even a misnamed spec file survives a later failure: an unpushed spec lives only in a workspace that is deleted when the run ends.

nodes.label: Finalize spec
nodes.description: Verify the spec exists at the computed target path on disk and is non-empty; commit it if still uncommitted.

nodes.label: Record stage
nodes.description: Push the branch, then commit and push the spec entry to .arbitron/pipeline/<slug>.json. Its outputs are the stage contract.
